product_owner.bio: I decide what goes into the backlog and what doesn't, always with the user in mind.

project_manager.bio: I keep the project on schedule and warn you before anything slips.

scrum_master.bio: I remove blockers so the team can move without friction.

business_analyst.bio: I understand the business problem and write it down so it can be built.

software_developer.bio: I handle code tasks across the whole stack, from idea to commit.

frontend_developer.bio: I turn designs into fast, accessible, polished interfaces.

backend_developer.bio: I take care of what you don't see: APIs, databases and business rules.

mobile_developer.bio: I put the product in your pocket with apps that feel native.

tech_lead.bio: I choose the architecture and help the team decide with good judgment.

code_reviewer.bio: I read every change carefully and flag what could break tomorrow.

qa_engineer.bio: I try to break what they build so your users don't.

devops_engineer.bio: I make shipping boring: automatic, repeatable and safe.

security_engineer.bio: I think like an attacker to close the door before anyone tries it.

data_analyst.bio: I cross-reference numbers until I find what is really going on.

data_engineer.bio: I move and clean data so others can trust it.

ux_ui_designer.bio: I make sure every screen makes sense at first glance.

technical_writer.bio: I explain complex things in simple words and examples that work.

support_engineer.bio: I get to the root of the problem and explain how to fix it.

marketing_specialist.bio: I tell people what you do and why it matters, in your brand's voice.

seo_specialist.bio: I research what people search for and tune your site to show up there.

sales_representative.bio: I listen first, propose second and take care of every opportunity.

customer_success_manager.bio: I make sure your customers achieve what they came for.

legal_advisor.bio: I review what you sign and tell you where the risk is.

financial_analyst.bio: I put numbers behind decisions: costs, margins and scenarios.

hr_specialist.bio: I handle hiring, team climate and everything about people.
